articles.headline: AC Milan condemn racist abuse of Mike Maignan after red card vs. Bournemouth
articles.description: AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss to Bournemouth.

articles.headline: 'If Mo Salah scores three...' - Hearts boss on puzzle to mark Trabzonspor star
articles.description: Wouter Vrancken hailed auxiliary left-back Rogers Mato for the way he stepped into the breach against Mohamed Salah as injury-hit Hearts produced a spirited display in a 2-0 Conference League defeat away to Trabzonspor.

articles.headline: Rose urges humility after Bournemouth rout Milan as Amorim rues red card
